title: Ask HN: How to speak like a leader, not like an engineer?
guide_zh: 被要求“像领导者那样说话”，技术经理怎样拓展工程师之外的管理视角？
author: yogrish
excerpt: I am a technical manager and currently in a leadership role. My manager who is an executive, keeps telling me“ don’t talk like an engineer, talk like a leader” when I go to him for any people or operational Issues. I always see from an engineer lens and possibly missing leader or executive perspective. How do I develop or change the way I talk as a leader. Did any one face this issue in the transition. Any pointers can be of great help.

title: Ask HN: Resources/Steps for Becoming a Consultant?
guide_zh: 已递辞呈却还没有下家，作者向全职顾问请教起步资源与常见陷阱。
author: MichaelEstes
excerpt: I recently put in my notice at work with nothing lined up. Do any of you operate full time as a consultant? I'd love to hear about how you got started and what resources, pitfalls, experiences you came across along the way.

title: Ask HN: Physicists of HN, what are you working on these days?
guide_zh: 除了常上头条的方向，HN 上的物理学家最近都在研究什么？
author: sachin18590
excerpt: Of late, except for few headline-friendly fields (colliders, quantum computing, gravitational waves and astrophysics in general), I don't get to see/relate with a lot of activities in Physics. Also I have noticed a growing trend of physicists becoming data scientists post phD. Although I understand the money factor, are there any other reasons for this as well?

title: Ask HN: Startup failed after years of work – Can I even get a job now?
guide_zh: 辍学创业七年即将关停，没有学历也久未受雇，该怎样重新求职？
